entries.title: Metro 2033

primary.why: Metro 2033 released on Windows and Xbox 360, then Metro 2033 Redux rebuilt it for modern platforms with updated technology and later reached Linux, macOS, Switch, and Stadia. Windows Redux is the highest-fidelity archive route because the PC Redux version has the best capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use Metro 2033 Redux on Windows. Use the original Windows release only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Metro Awakening

emulation.notes: Native PC VR; headset and GPU choice define fidelity ceiling.

primary.why: Metro Awakening is a VR prequel released for Meta Quest 2/3, PlayStation VR2, SteamVR, and Viveport. PC VR is the highest-fidelity archive route when headset and GPU are available, while Quest is the standalone convenience route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC VR/SteamVR version with the best available headset and GPU. Use Quest only if standalone capture is the goal.
